title: Lineage page looks up one object by name and detail pages show their own lineage

problem_register_binding.operator_approval: 2026-11-25 conversation 52a1dacf (照建議 全部處理好)
problem_register_binding.hosted_read_only_diagnosis: 2026-11-25 06:35Z to 07:16Z on BFF adc027da9: opening /management/lineage requested the unrooted 240-node graph where every node label equaled its raw ID; typing persona-ee71 fired 11 GET /bff/lineage requests; searching 衡岳 found nothing; ArtifactDetail.tsx line 240 never called GET /bff/lineage.

details: Opening /management/lineage without ?root= sends zero GET /bff/lineage requests, renders data-testid='lineage-lookup-prompt', and loads current strategies (bffV1.strategies.listNonDraft) and current personas (bffV1.personas.list) offered by name with secondary ID.

Typing in the root lookup input (including typing 'persona-ee71' character by character or typing Chinese name '衡岳') updates only queryInput and filters the candidate options without firing any GET /bff/lineage request.

GET /bff/lineage?root_id=<id> is sent only when the user selects a candidate option, presses Enter, or opens a ?root=<id> deep link; pressing Enter after typing a Chinese name resolves to the matching strategy/persona ID.

adaptLineageNode in src/lib/bff-v1/managementConsoleReads.ts preserves display_name, name_missing, strategy_id, and version from REGISTRY-LINEAGE-NODE-NAMES-20261125 while remaining backward-compatible when those fields are absent.

resolveLineageNodeLabel in src/lib/enumLabels.ts renders display_name as primary text with the full node id on [data-node-secondary-id], and falls back to localized plain kind plus short id (e.g. '資金池 a81b4fd1' / 'Capital Pool a81b4fd1', '產出物 a81b4fd1-v2' / 'Artifact a81b4fd1-v2', '實驗 a81b4fd1' / 'Experiment a81b4fd1') when name_missing is true or when display_name is absent and label equals id.

Type filter labels (BFF_LINEAGE_NODE_TYPES: 策略/Strategy, Persona, 產出物/Artifact, 資金池/Capital Pool, 實驗/Experiment, 資料集/Dataset), edge labels (BFF_LINEAGE_EDGE_TYPES including source_dataset: 來源資料集/Source Dataset), empty (lineage.empty: 尚無血緣資料。/No lineage available.), and unavailable (lineageExplorer.unavailable: 血緣服務不可用。/Lineage surface unavailable.) are translated in both zh-TW and en-US.

StrategyDetail.tsx and ArtifactDetail.tsx both read managementConsoleReads.lineage(id) for their lineage tab, render LineageGraph when ready, distinguish unavailable (strategy-lineage-unavailable / artifact-lineage-unavailable) from empty (lineage-empty), and highlight the current object.

highlightLineageNodesForRoot matches both direct node IDs (for artifacts, personas, and capital pools) and Strategy spec nodes (by strategy_id or reg-strategy-spec-<suffix>) when rooted at a strategy ID such as strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa.

LineageGraph.tsx uses CJK-aware estimateTextPx and fitText so full-width Chinese titles stay inside [NODE_PAD_X, NODE_W - NODE_PAD_X] and widens colGap for translated edge labels so edge labels stay strictly inside inter-column gaps.

Verified in real Chromium at 1274x627 and 390x844 across /management/lineage, /management/strategies/strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa (Lineage tab), and /management/artifacts/artifact-persona-pool-a81b4fd15944698341aa-v2 (Lineage tab) that clippedNodes=[] and overlappingEdges=[].

changed_assertions_justification.change: Updated the three existing graph-rendering test entries from unrooted '/management/lineage' to rooted '/management/lineage?root=...', updated type filter button lookup to use localized lineageNodeTypeLabel(c.type, i18n.t), and dispatched Enter after rootInput change when testing root reload.
changed_assertions_justification.reason: Per AC1, AC2, and AC5, opening /management/lineage without ?root= no longer requests an unrooted graph, type filter buttons are now localized in zh-TW and en-US instead of hardcoded English enum keys, and root reload triggers on Enter or selection rather than on every keystroke.

changed_assertions_justification.change: Updated empty-state text expectation on data-testid='lineage-empty' from hardcoded English 'No lineage available.' to /No lineage available\.|尚無血緣資料。/.
changed_assertions_justification.reason: Per AC2, LineageGraph empty state is now localized through t('lineage.empty') in zh-TW ('尚無血緣資料。') and en-US ('No lineage available.').

changed_assertions_justification.change: Updated the canonical lineage read case from '/management/lineage' to '/management/lineage?root=artifact-canonical'.
changed_assertions_justification.reason: Per AC1 and AC5, unrooted /management/lineage sends no /bff/lineage graph request; rooted ?root=artifact-canonical verifies the canonical /bff/lineage graph read.

validation.result: 5 passed (canonical reads, lineage lookup + detail tabs + 1274x627 & 390w geometry + screenshots, and persona fleet click-map regression)
